dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Nice to meet you.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願い致しますすみませんちがうところになっていました
dialogue.content: Nice to meet you. I'm sorry, I was in the wrong place.

dialogue.origin: ここからよろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: Let's start from here.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: ご相談ありがとうございますはじめに年齢、性別、ご相談内容を教えていただけますでしょうか。
dialogue.content: Thank you for reaching out. To begin, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you would like to discuss?

dialogue.origin: 18、男。課題発表がいやで学校に行きたくありません。
dialogue.content: I'm 18, male. I have to give a presentation for an assignment, and I hate it so much that I don't want to go to school.

dialogue.origin: 課題発表があり学校に行きたくないのですね
dialogue.content: I see—you don’t want to go to school because of an assignment presentation.

dialogue.origin: 課題が難しすぎて良くわからないので発表してもバカにされると思います。
dialogue.content: The assignment is too difficult and I don't understand it well, so I think I’ll be made fun of if I present it.

dialogue.origin: がんばった課題を発表してもバカにされると思われているのですか
dialogue.content: You feel that even if you present the assignment you worked hard on, you’ll be made fun of?

dialogue.origin: はい、頑張っていないので
dialogue.content: Yes, because I haven’t really worked hard on it.

dialogue.origin: 頑張ってないのですか難しい課題はどんな課題なのでしょう
dialogue.content: I see—you haven’t been able to put much effort into it. What kind of difficult assignment is it?

dialogue.origin: 調べても良くわからない科学関係の課題です
dialogue.content: It's a science-related assignment that I don't understand well, even after doing research.

dialogue.origin: それは難しそうですね
dialogue.content: That does sound difficult.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 一人でされるのでしょうか一緒にしらべる人とかいらっしゃいかすか
dialogue.content: Are you doing it by yourself? Is there anyone you can research with?

dialogue.origin: 一人です
dialogue.content: I'm doing it alone.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。それは不安になりますね。
dialogue.content: I see. That must make you anxious.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ほかの方はどうやってしらべているのでしょう
dialogue.content: How are the other students doing their research?

dialogue.origin: よくわかりません
dialogue.content: I don't really know.

dialogue.origin: 先生にわからないことを聴いてみるのはどうでしょうか
dialogue.content: What about asking your teacher about the things you don't understand?

dialogue.origin: ヒントをもらえるかもしれませんよ
dialogue.content: You might be able to get some hints.

dialogue.origin: 自分で調べろというスタイルです。そんなこと聞いてもとりあわないとおもいます。
dialogue.content: Their style is to tell us to figure it out ourselves. I don't think they would pay any attention if I asked.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。それは悩みますよね。
dialogue.content: I see. That must be troubling.

dialogue.origin: 課題をひとりでみんなの前ではなすことも緊張してしまいそうですね
dialogue.content: It must also be nerve-wracking to present the assignment by yourself in front of everyone.

dialogue.origin: いやです
dialogue.content: I hate it.

dialogue.origin: みんなの前で話すのが嫌なんでしょうか
dialogue.content: Is it speaking in front of everyone that you dislike?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね緊張されるのでしょうか普段はどんな感じなのでしょう
dialogue.content: I see. Do you tend to get nervous? How is it for you in general?

dialogue.origin: 普段は普通ですが
dialogue.content: I'm usually fine.

dialogue.origin: 人前で緊張するとかもないのでしょうかでも課題発表は嫌ですね
dialogue.content: So you don’t usually get nervous in front of others, but you still dislike the assignment presentation.

dialogue.origin: そういうことではなく課題発表が嫌なんです
dialogue.content: It's not that. It's the assignment presentation itself that I hate.

dialogue.origin: 課題発表が嫌なのですね。課題は出来上がりそうですか
dialogue.content: It's the assignment presentation you dislike. Is the assignment close to being finished?

dialogue.origin: ちょー適当です
dialogue.content: It's really half-assed.

dialogue.origin: 適当でも仕上がっているのですね凄いじゃないですか
dialogue.content: Even if you feel it's half-assed, you've finished it. Isn't that amazing?

dialogue.origin: そうですか、テキトーです。
dialogue.content: You think so? It's just thrown together.

dialogue.origin: 自信を持って発表できなさそうなのでしょうか出来てるだけでもすごいと思いますが
dialogue.content: Do you feel you can't present it with confidence? I think just having it done is amazing.

dialogue.origin: いや。ばかにされます。頭のいい人ばかりなので
dialogue.content: No. I'll be made fun of. Everyone is so smart.

dialogue.origin: 折角できているのにどうしてバカにされると思われるのでしょう。見せあいとかされないのでしょうか
dialogue.content: You've gone to the trouble of finishing it, so why do you think you'll be made fun of? Do you not show your work to each other?

dialogue.origin: 見せ合いはありません。だれもしていません。
dialogue.content: We don’t show each other. No one does.

dialogue.origin: 見せ合いしないのですね。不安な時はどうせれていらっしゃいますか悩みますね。。
dialogue.content: So you don't share your work. What do you usually do when you feel anxious? It's a tough situation.

dialogue.origin: 今回初めてです。嫌で仕方ないので相談しました。
dialogue.content: This is the first time. I hated it so much that I decided to talk to someone.

dialogue.origin: 悩まれたでしょうね。どうすれば発表出来ると思われますか
dialogue.content: You must have been struggling with this. What do you think might help you be able to present?

dialogue.origin: 思いつきません
dialogue.content: I can’t think of anything.

dialogue.origin: バカにされると思われてるのは他にも何か心配事とかありますか
dialogue.content: Regarding the feeling that you'll be made fun of, are there any other things you're worried about?

dialogue.origin: みんな優秀なので交流は少ないです
dialogue.content: Everyone is so brilliant, so I don't interact with them much.

dialogue.origin: みんなが優秀だと思われているのですねご自身は自分のことをどんなふうに思われているのでしょうか
dialogue.content: So you feel that everyone else is brilliant. How do you see yourself?

dialogue.origin: 周りが優秀なので居心地が悪いです。自分はバカな人間だとおもいます
dialogue.content: I feel out of place because everyone around me is so brilliant. I think I'm a stupid person.

dialogue.origin: そう思っていらっしゃるのですね難しい課題をしあげているのに適当でも凄いと思います
dialogue.content: That's how you see yourself. Even so, I think it's amazing that you've completed a difficult assignment, even if you feel it's half-assed.

dialogue.origin: そうですか
dialogue.content: You think so?

dialogue.origin: はい。そう思いましたが、がんばれそうですか
dialogue.content: Yes, that’s what I think. Do you feel like you might be able to give it a try?

dialogue.origin: 嫌ですが仕方ないですね・・・
dialogue.content: I hate it, but I guess I have no choice...

dialogue.origin: そうなのですねそろそろお時間なのですが、思いを話せたでしょうか
dialogue.content: I see. We’re about out of time—were you able to share what you wanted to?

dialogue.origin: まあ
dialogue.content: More or less.

dialogue.origin: 勇気をだしてお話し本当にありがとうございます。難しいかも知れませんがこの勇気で発表に挑戦してみてはいかがでしょうか
dialogue.content: Thank you so much for gathering your courage to speak with me. It might be difficult, but how about using this courage to try and do the presentation?

dialogue.origin: はい・・・、では時間なので失礼します。
dialogue.content: Yes... Well, it's time, so I'll be going.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございましたこちらで終了になりますがよろしいでしょうか
dialogue.content: Thank you very much. We will end the session here, is that alright?

dialogue.origin: すみません　ありがとうございましたこれで終了いたします
dialogue.content: My apologies. Thank you very much. We will end it here.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: 本日ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you for your time today.

topic.sub: 課題発表に対する不安
